# GMEOW Affect Module

The GMEOW Affect Module — emotions as intrinsic modes and appraisals as vantage-indexed observations (issue #356, EPIC #348). DELIBERATELY THIN.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/affect>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/affect`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Emotions and appraisals — the thinnest slice in the repo, by commitment.

DOCTRINE.
  * THIN MEANS THIN (Principle 15 discipline): this slice ships the minimum its named consumers require and STOPS. Growth requires a new consumer, not modeling pleasure; docs.md records the size budget and what demand would justify expansion (a sensory-environment or narrative consumer).
  * An Emotion is an intrinsic mode inhering in one agent (the Desire/Intention pattern, #350). Episodic scope rides validFrom/validUntil on the statement — NO tenure class here (thin means thin); promote to the StandpointTenure idiom only if a consumer ever demands it.
  * EmotionType is an OPEN vocabulary seeded from the EmotionML standard sets (Plutchik's primary eight); registry-independent, contestable, never a tree (the Genre/Register precedent).
  * APPRAISALS ARE OBSERVATIONS: dimensional readings (PAD: valence, arousal, dominance) and qualitative aesthetic judgements (elegance, sublimity, kitsch — open) are vantage-indexed cells. Two critics disagreeing are two cells (Principle 9). Attributed emotion vs self-report is the vantage axis too: self-report is top authority for the subject's own standpoint (the facetVantage precedent) — docs, no new machinery.
